description: Balanced paired corpus of source-linked hypothesis claims across R03-R06 traces: 6 development packets (3 matched pairs), 10 held-out evaluation packets (5 matched pairs, anonymized as P01-P10), and 2 offline-only gold residual boundary controls (G01-G02).

claim.rationale: Selected one representative csu-* ID per distinct segment correspondence (13 sets total) with residue_policy='drop' to reconstruct all 19 concepts at node x.
claim.directionality_rationale: Representative local choices cover the phonological inventory; remaining sets are dropped as residue.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: In R04c (c-local-qwen36-35b-r04), local csu-* IDs are scoped to individual cognate units, not global phoneme rules. Claiming only 13 of 57 sets under residue_policy='drop' drops 56.7% of columns and produces empty output on 9 of 19 concepts including y03.

claim.rationale: Outgroup evidence in cs311 is evenly split between attestation in f (t-a-kʰ) and absence in d (t-a), requiring 2 changes under either hypothesis; unresolved, confidence assigned 0.5. All 57 local sets are explicitly claimed.
claim.directionality_rationale: 1-1 tie in same-unit outgroups (d=t a, f=t a kʰ; c=r e g is non-cognate cs322); committed at confidence 0.5.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Paired control for DP1: uses the same residue_policy='drop' at node x, but explicitly covers all 57/57 local sets (unaccounted_column_rate=0.0) and marks the 1-1 same-unit outgroup split on y03 at confidence=0.5.

claim.directionality_rationale: Retain *p i k as unannotated whole-word string.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: R05 Arm b2 demonstrates that replacing cog:two_level_propagation_v1:c001 with whole:unknown (cognate_set_id=None) triggers unknown_whole=True in align_tuple at parent r, collapsing task04-units-v1 cognate_unit_exact from 10/10 to 0/10 and r02-decisions-v1 to 0/8 (unit_missing).

claim.rationale: Both active child forms a:c001 and b:c001 come from an unannotated whole-word slice (unit_id='whole:unknown', cognate_set_id=None); preserving whole:unknown on the assembled candidate records unknown cognacy honestly.
claim.directionality_rationale: Outgroups c and d attest initial p; a innovated p > f / #_.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Paired control for DP2: when the leaf forms themselves have no supplied cognacy annotation (child_source_unit_ids=['whole:unknown', 'whole:unknown']), emitting whole:unknown is required by the evidence contract ('Unknown analysis is unknown, not a manufactured objection').

claim.rationale: No outgroup evidence for w01. Tie: *k (b loss) vs *∅ (a innovation). Retaining *k.
claim.directionality_rationale: No outgroup evidence for w01; treating <a k : b Ø> as a 1-1 tie and retaining *k.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: In R03c (b-local-qwen), get_alignments call 148471901 showed c:w01 = ['p', 'a'] in the same cognate unit cog:c42. Outgroup c is present in cog:c42 and lacks final -k (attesting absence: 1 gain in a vs 2 losses in b and c). Treating absence of a survey witness as 'No outgroup evidence for w01' confuses attested segment absence with a missing outgroup form.

claim.rationale: Initial [p, p] -> *p in unit cog:c42 (support=1 in local unit reading, recurring identically in cog:c11 on w03) is repeated identical retention, and final <a k : b Ø> -> None because same-unit outgroup c:w01 (p a in cog:c42) attests absence.
claim.directionality_rationale: Initial *p retained in a, b, c; final -k innovated in a only (c:w01 = p a in cog:c42).

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Paired control for DP3 (and Task 04 false-merger control): support=1 is expected for single-etymon local unit sets, repeated identical retention [p, p] -> *p across units is NOT a merger, and discounting final -k when c:w01='p a' in cog:c42 is parsimoniously exact.

claim.rationale: Outgroup c attests voiced velar reflex g in cs379 (c:y04 = p a g), while d:y04 (w u in cs332) and f:y04 (r o in cs364) belong to non-cognate replacement units (no observation for cs379), so 1-of-1 same-unit outgroup supports retention of *k.
claim.directionality_rationale: Same-unit outgroup c (p a g in cog:cs379) preserves the final velar slot as g; b lost *-k (1 loss on x->b vs 2 independent gains on x->a and r->c).

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: On Stage C K9 (y04, cog:cs379), outgroups d (cs332) and f (cs364) are non-cognate replacements (0 observations in cs379), while c:y04='p a g' is in cog:cs379 and attests the regular shifted reflex g. All outgroup forms were inspected in call_dc9b5e3c24f442eab71fc8409ff9 and call_47137f0995844458883e8f8402ee.

claim.rationale: At root r, 2 of 3 active children with forms in cog:cs397 (reconstructed child x = s i k at probability 1.0 and leaf d = s i k, against leaf f = s i; c has no form) attest final -k, establishing a 2-of-3 majority for *k at confidence 0.90.
claim.directionality_rationale: Active-child majority {x, d} vs {f} requires only 1 loss on r->f, whereas ancestral absence would require 2 independent gains on r->x and r->d.

prior_node_commit_summary.rationale_at_node: Outgroup evidence in cs397 is evenly split between attestation in d (s-i-k) and absence in f (s-i), requiring 2 changes under either hypothesis; unresolved, confidence assigned 0.5.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: R05 §5 (c-gemini-r04 replay on T1 y05): at child node x, a:y05='s i k' and b:y05='s i' was committed at confidence=0.50 (csu-49b21ea93bc30b4926e9664b) as an unresolved tie. Under single-winner assembly (tied_confidence_threshold=None), x emitted only 's i k' at probability=1.0, turning a genuine 2-vs-2 whole-tree leaf tie ({a, d} vs {b, f}) into a false 2-of-3 active-child majority at r.

claim.rationale: Commit unanimous identity correspondences <x k : y k> -> *k, <x o : y o> -> *o, and <x t : y t> -> *t at confidence = 0.95 under tied_confidence_threshold = 0.5 so that *k o and *k o t remain in an exact 0.5000 / 0.5000 tie at root r.
claim.directionality_rationale: Unanimous identity correspondences across x and y at confidence 0.95 preserve the 2-vs-2 parsimony tie without tie-break bias.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: R05 §4 operational_weight_sensitivity on L2 (c012): because ProtoInventoryAssembler sums log(confidence) across columns, setting confidence=0.95 < 1.0 on unanimous identity sets penalizes 3-column (k o t, k o t) by 3*log(0.95) vs 2*log(0.95) for 2-column (k o, k o), skewing probabilities to 0.5063 vs 0.4937 (decided_by_tie_break=False) instead of an exact 0.5000 / 0.5000 tie at confidence=1.0.

claim.rationale: Reconstruct *ɢ (rather than *q) as the proto-phoneme label for the regular dorsal correspondence <a x : b ɢ : c ʔ> on d07 (*ɢ a l a) and d08 (*l a ɢ a), paired with the ordered forward cascade [1] k > tʃ / _ i, [2] i > e / _ #, [3] t > Ø / _ #, [4] ɢ > x, [5] w > v / # _ on branch r -> a.
claim.directionality_rationale: The unanchored proto-symbol *ɢ preserves the exact corpus-wide contrast partition (corpus_bcubed_f1 = 1.000, is_bijective_relabelling = True) and predicts 8/8 development reflexes and 8/8 held-out reflexes on daughter a.

contrast_equivalence_summary.note: Inferred *ɢ maps 1-to-1 with reference *q across all alignment columns without merger or split.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: R06 §5.2 (h2_equivalent_ancestral_label): unanchored comparative reconstruction identifies ancestral contrasts up to bijective symbol relabelling. Because (*ɢ, ɢ > x) is bijective (corpus_bcubed_f1=1.0, is_bijective_relabelling=True) and achieves 8/8 exact fit on daughter reflexes, flagging *ɢ vs *q is a false objection.

claim.rationale: On y14 (cog:cs312), active child a has t e k and b has t e. Outgroups d (t e k) and f (t e + kʰ a) both contain a velar stop after the stem vowel e (2 of 3 outgroups, against c = t e), so 2-of-3 outgroup majority supports retaining stem-final *k in cog:cs312.
claim.directionality_rationale: Counting velar stops across outgroups d and f gives 2-of-3 outgroup support for *k in cog:cs312; b and c lost the stop.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Stage C K8 (y14, cog:cs312): in f:y14 ('t e + kʰ a'), the stem piece in cog:cs312 is 't e' (lacking a final stop), while 'kʰ a' belongs to suffix unit cog:cs338. Within cog:cs312, 2 of 3 outgroups (c='t e' and f's cs312 piece 't e') lack the final stop vs only 1 (d='t e k') attesting it, so parsimony requires proto_segment=None (absent), not 'k'.

claim.rationale: At root r on y07 (cog:cs369), 3 of 4 active children (reconstructed child x = o k, committed at confidence = 0.90, plus leaf outgroups c = o g and d = h o k, against f = o) attest the final velar stop, supporting retention of *k at confidence 0.90.
claim.directionality_rationale: Child x's *k was established with high confidence (0.90) from 2-of-3 outgroups (c=o g, d=h o k), and across the whole tree {a, c, d} vs {b, f} favors *k (2 losses on b, f vs 3 independent gains).

prior_node_commit_summary.rationale_at_node: Two outgroups (c, d) attest final velar stop in cs369 vs 1 absence in f, favoring retention.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Paired control for EP1: at root r on HK2-final (y07, cog:cs369), child x's candidate 'o k' was committed at confidence=0.90 (> 0.50) based on 2-of-3 outgroups (c='o g', d='h o k' vs f='o'), and remains width-1 under tied_confidence_threshold=0.5. Retaining *k at r at confidence=0.90 is a genuine 3-vs-2 whole-tree parsimony win (2 losses on b, f vs 3 gains on a, c, d).

claim.rationale: Under swapped child order ((b,a)x,c,d,f)r;, active children show <b Ø : a k> in cog:cs326. Outgroups c and f have no form (-), and d:y09 (j o k) belongs to non-cognate replacement unit cog:cs331 (0 same-unit outgroups). Retention (1 loss in b) and absence (1 gain in a) tie at 1 change each; marked unresolved at confidence = 0.50.
claim.directionality_rationale: Genuine 1-1 parsimony tie with 0 same-unit outgroup witnesses (d:y09 is non-cognate cog:cs331); child order (b, a) vs (a, b) does not alter the tie.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Paired control for EP3 (combining genuine ambiguity T3 y09 with R05's active-child order swap perturbation ((b,a)x,c,d,f)r;): d:y09 ('j o k' in cog:cs331) is rightly excluded as a non-cognate replacement unit, leaving 0 same-unit outgroups and a genuine 1-1 tie committed at confidence=0.50.

claim.rationale: Nineteen correspondence sets show 'k' in child a and null in child b. Outgroups (c, d, f) regularly show velar stops (k, kʰ, g). This indicates proto *k was retained as 'k' in a but lost in b.
claim.directionality_rationale: Child a shows 'k' consistently across 19 sets while child b shows null. Outgroups c, d, f regularly show velar stops (k, kʰ, g) in corresponding positions, supporting proto *k.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: Banked R04c (c-local-qwen36-35b-r04, call_18f5646833af183784b0dd5fc8e8872b_0 on csu-a26f6177f60d0b20f8936d2b / y01 cog:cs305): (1) the session never called search_forms, get_alignments, or polarize (concept_outgroup_forms_seen=False, 0 outgroup forms seen) yet cited outgroups c, d, f; (2) on y01, only c:y01='l o' is in cog:cs305 (attesting absence of -k), while d:y01 ('w a k' in cs351) and f:y01 ('j i kʰ' in cs323) are non-cognate replacements.

claim.directionality_rationale: Unanimous retention of *l and *o across all four leaves (a, b: l o k; c, d: l o g) and regular velar voicing *-k > *-g in clade y.

claim.rationale: Account for daughter a's reflexes from *r using the ordered parent-to-child cascade [1] i > e / _ #, [2] k > tʃ / _ i, [3] t > Ø / _ #, [4] q > x, [5] w > v / # _; if d01 (*p a k i -> a: p a tʃ e) and d02 (*f a k i -> a: f a tʃ e) fail to palatalize, revise by appending [6] k > tʃ / _ e.
claim.directionality_rationale: Apply final vowel lowering i > e / _ # first, then palatalize k before front vowels via k > tʃ / _ e.

ground_truth.independent_derivation_note: R06 §5.1 (h3_wrong_order_bleeding): ordering i > e / _ # before k > tʃ / _ i bleeds palatalization on d01 (*p a k i -> p a k e vs observed p a tʃ e) and d02 (*f a k i -> f a k e vs observed f a tʃ e). Appending k > tʃ / _ e repairs d01 and d02 but newly breaks d03 (*p a k e -> p a tʃ e vs observed p a k e); the non-breaking fix is counterbleeding order k > tʃ / _ i before i > e / _ #.
